description: Engine setup of map0_s01 (Old Silent Hill - cafe), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type THR, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: AirScreamer, NightFlutter, Cybil and EndingCybil). "effect_draws" lists the effect slot drawers the map has; an effect slot of any other kind is not drawn. Here: glass_shards (breaking glass shards). A mod changes it with its own maps/map0_s01/overlay.json.
